Frailty is one of the Skill nodes on the Harvest skill tree.

## Node Description

Harvest hits have a chance to reduce enemy poison protection.

### Mechanics[]

Poison Protection Shred reduces Poison Protection by 100, lasts 4 seconds, and can stack.

Poison Protection Shred Chance: +20% per point.
